title: Marketing Manager
description:
**Job description:**

Marketing Manager

**Location:** Sovabazar, Kolkata

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Experience:** 4+ years preferred

**About IND:**

The Institute of NeuroDevelopment (IND) is a mission-driven organisation working to transform the developmental journeys of children with autism and other neurodevelopmental differences.

Our work spans child development, parent education, assessments, therapy, research, digital education, community engagement, professional training and other initiatives aimed at improving outcomes for children and their families.

As IND grows, we are building a strong marketing function that can understand our audiences deeply, build trust, communicate our value effectively, create demand for our programmes and services, and establish IND as a trusted and differentiated organisation.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a Marketing Manager who fundamentally understands marketing, rather than someone who is primarily a salesperson or a digital-platform operator.

The Marketing Manager will be responsible for developing and executing marketing strategies across both online and offline channels.

**The role requires a strong understanding of-**

i) customer psychology, market positioning, segmentation, value propositions, brand building, demand generation, content marketing, campaign development, customer journeys and conversion funnels.

ii) Digital channels will form an important part of the role, but technology and platforms are means of executing marketing strategy, not substitutes for marketing thinking.

iii) The ideal candidate should be able to understand an audience, identify what matters to them, formulate the right proposition and message, develop campaigns around those insights, coordinate execution across teams and measure whether the marketing is actually producing meaningful outcomes.

iv) This is a hands-on leadership role. The candidate should be capable of developing strategy while also getting into the details required to make it work.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Marketing Strategy**

Develop and execute marketing strategies for IND's various offerings, including:

\* Consultations

\* Assessments

\* Webinars

\* Bootcamps

\* Parent programmes

\* Therapy and developmental services

\* Educational programmes

\* Professional training

\* Publications

\* New products and services as they are developed

For each offering, determine:

\* Target audience

\* Audience segment

\* Customer need

\* Market opportunity

\* Positioning

\* Value proposition

\* Core message

\* Offer structure

\* Customer journey

\* Appropriate channels

\* Campaign approach

\* Measurement framework

**2. Audience & Consumer Understanding**

Develop a deep understanding of IND's audiences, particularly parents and families.

Understand:

\* Their existing beliefs

\* Their concerns and fears

\* Their aspirations

\* Their unmet needs

\* Their information-seeking behaviour

\* Their objections

\* Their decision-making process

\* Their trust barriers

\* What motivates them to act

\* What prevents them from acting

Translate these insights into practical marketing strategies and campaigns.

**3. Positioning & Messaging**

Develop and refine the positioning of IND and its individual offerings.

The candidate will work on:

\* Brand positioning

\* Product and programme positioning

\* Value propositions

\* Campaign messages

\* Communication themes

\* Differentiators

\* Offers

\* Calls to action

The objective is to communicate clearly why IND's approach, programmes or services are relevant and valuable to the intended audience.

All communication should remain responsible, evidence-informed and appropriate to the sensitive nature of our work with children and families.

**4. Campaign Development**

Conceptualise, develop and lead marketing campaigns from beginning to end.

A typical campaign may involve:

Audience insight

→ Marketing objective

→ Campaign concept

→ Positioning & message

→ Content & creative

→ Distribution

→ Lead capture

→ Nurturing

→ Conversion

→ Measurement & learning

The Marketing Manager should be capable of owning this entire chain and coordinating the specialists responsible for individual components.

**5. Content Marketing**

Work closely with the Storyteller/Scriptwriter, Content & Creative team and other content contributors to develop:

\* Content pillars

\* Editorial themes

\* Educational content

\* Awareness campaigns

\* Parent education content

\* Thought leadership

\* Long-form content

\* Short-form content

\* Video campaigns

\* Podcast-related content

\* Webinar content

\* Lead magnets

\* Campaign-specific content

The candidate should be able to distinguish between content that generates attention and content that contributes meaningfully to marketing objectives.

**6. Digital Marketing**

Lead the marketing strategy across relevant digital channels, including:

\* Search

\* Social media

\* YouTube

\* Email

\* WhatsApp

\* Websites and landing pages

\* CRM

\* Online communities

\* Digital advertising

The candidate should understand platforms such as Meta and Google and be able to evaluate their effectiveness.

They do not necessarily need to personally execute every technical aspect of every campaign, but they must understand how digital channels fit into the broader marketing system.

**7. Demand & Lead Generation**

Develop systems for generating qualified demand through:

\* Organic content

\* Paid campaigns

\* Search

\* Referrals

\* Partnerships

\* Webinars

\* Events

\* Communities

\* Email

\* WhatsApp

\* Existing parent and professional networks

\* Other relevant channels

Work closely with the Digital Growth Manager to improve the quantity and quality of demand generated.

The focus should be on qualified prospects and meaningful business outcomes rather than lead volume alone.

**8. Customer Journey & Funnel Development**

Map and continuously improve the customer journey:

Awareness

→ Interest

→ Engagement

→ Lead

→ Trust Building

→ Consultation / Webinar / Assessment

→ Programme / Service

→ Retention

→ Referral

Identify points at which prospective clients lose interest or fail to progress and determine what marketing intervention may improve the journey.

**9. Marketing & Sales Alignment**

Work closely with the Sales and Community Engagement teams to understand:

\* Lead quality

\* Common objections

\* Reasons for non-conversion

\* Customer feedback

\* Competitive alternatives

\* Pricing concerns

\* Messaging gaps

\* Reasons for withdrawal or drop-off

Use these insights to continuously improve marketing.

The Marketing Manager is not primarily a salesperson, but must understand how marketing ultimately influences customer decisions.

**10. Brand Development**

Contribute to building IND as a trusted and differentiated brand among:

\* Parents and families

\* Professionals

\* Educators

\* Schools

\* Healthcare professionals

\* Organisations

\* Researchers

\* The wider public

Maintain consistency in:

\* Positioning

\* Brand voice

\* Communication

\* Visual identity

\* Public messaging

**11. Marketing Analytics & ROI**

Measure marketing based on meaningful outcomes rather than vanity metrics.

Track and analyse, as applicable:

\* Qualified leads

\* Cost per qualified lead

\* Lead-to-consultation conversion

\* Consultation-to-programme conversion

\* Customer acquisition cost

\* Marketing-attributed revenue

\* Campaign ROI

\* Channel contribution

\* Organic demand

\* Referral contribution

\* Audience growth

\* Engagement quality

The Marketing Manager should continuously ask:

> Are we reaching the right people, with the right message, through the right channel, at the right point in their journey?

**12. Team & Partner Management**

Provide marketing direction and coordinate with:

\* Digital Growth Manager

\* Content & Creative team

\* Storytellers and Scriptwriters

\* Community Engagement team

\* Sales team

\* Designers

\* Video editors

\* External agencies

\* Freelancers

\* Other marketing partners

The Marketing Manager should establish the marketing direction and priorities, while ensuring that specialists have the clarity and resources required for execution.

**What We Are Looking For-**

We are looking for someone who:

\* Is genuinely passionate about marketing.

\* Thinks deeply about customers and consumer behaviour.

\* Understands marketing beyond digital platforms.

\* Enjoys figuring out why people make decisions.

\* Can develop positioning and value propositions.

\* Can turn audience insights into campaigns.

\* Understands both brand and performance marketing.

\* Can connect marketing activity to business outcomes.

\* Is comfortable working across online and offline channels.

\* Can lead specialists while remaining hands-on.

\* Is comfortable testing ideas and learning from results.

\* Has strong analytical and strategic thinking.

\* Can work in an evolving organisation where the marketing system is still being built.

**What This Role Is Not**

This is not primarily:

\* A Business Development role

\* A Sales role

\* A Telecalling role

\* A Performance Marketing-only role

\* A Social Media Manager role

\* An Ads Operations role

Someone who can operate Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads but cannot explain the target customer, customer motivation, positioning, value proposition and campaign logic would not be considered a strong fit.

Similarly, someone whose primary experience is outbound sales or lead conversion should not be considered a marketing candidate merely because their previous designation was "Business Development Executive".

**Required Experience-**

\* Minimum 4 years of relevant marketing experience preferred.

\* Demonstrated experience developing and executing marketing campaigns.

\* Strong understanding of consumer behaviour and customer psychology.

\* Experience with content marketing.

\* Experience with digital marketing channels.

\* Understanding of lead generation and conversion funnels.

\* Experience analysing marketing performance.

\* Experience coordinating teams, agencies or external partners.

\* Demonstrated ability to take a marketing initiative from concept to execution.

**Preferred Background-**

Candidates with experience in the following environments may be particularly relevant:

\* Consumer marketing

\* FMCG

\* D2C

\* Healthcare

\* Education

\* Advertising

\* Brand management
